rejected_rule.statement: A mortgagee's title cannot gain priority over a subsequent partition sale unless the mortgage decree is registered according to law.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "Section 12 of the Partition Ordinance continues to protect the rights of the mortgagee until he has made them effective according to law. A purchaser at a subsequent partition sale, which was held between the sale in execution of the mortgage decree and the Fiscal's transfer, cannot claim priority by virtue of the mortgagee until he has made them effective according to law."
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Registration of Documents Ordinance (Cap. 101), s. 8, proviso 1 -Partition Ordinance (Cap. 56), s. 12.
